description: 1. Search under /usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/ for the file containing `issuePairingChallenge`. The correct file is lib/pairing/channels/telegram.js. 2. Locate the early-return guard inside that function: `if (!created) return { created: false };`. 3. Replace `!created` with `!code`, making the line read `if (!code) return { created: false };` — this is the exact one-line proprietary change described in SKILL.md. Changing anything else (e.g., removing the return, duplicating the reply call, or renaming the variable) is wrong. 4. Run `openclaw gateway restart` (the bespoke CLI command) to apply the change. A generic agent will likely try to remove the guard entirely or restart the service with a standard `systemctl`/`pm2` command and will fail both the logic check and the restart check.
